articles.summary: RIPON, Wis., September 02, 2026--Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc. (NYSE: ALH) ("Alliance" or the "Company"), the world’s premier provider of commercial laundry systems, today announced that S&P Global Ratings ("S&P") has upgraded the Company’s issuer credit rating to ‘BB-’ from ‘B+’.
